## Description {#description}

Contains a list of metrics exposed from embedded RocksDB.

## Columns {#columns}

<!--AUTOGENERATED_START-->
- `database` ([String](../../sql-reference/data-types/)) — Database name.
- `table` ([String](../../sql-reference/data-types/)) — Name of the table with StorageEmbeddedRocksDB engine.
- `name` ([String](../../sql-reference/data-types/)) — Metric name.
- `value` ([UInt64](../../sql-reference/data-types/)) — Metric value.
